No new Actions proof run or temporary CI workflow was created because direct Neon read-only access was available; this artifact is repository+live-Neon inspection evidence.
The presence of source/decision data in WIP Git is not by itself a migration failure; a migration gap arises only if those files retain competing canonical final authority.
The separate default Neon production branch is empty and lacks attack-event schema; this does not imply cutover must target that branch without an explicit architecture decision.
The historical Kyiv development-only discovery corpus and casualty source adjudication are excluded and do not delay this infrastructure audit.
